> - **Is Blue City available on both Java and Bedrock Edition?**
> - Yes! Blue City supports both Java and Bedrock players on the same server.

> - **How can I join Blue City?**
> - You can join Blue City through adding a server and typing the IP bluecity.sennahosting.com`and if you're on bedrock, use the port 25575.

> - **Is Blue City P2W (pay-to-win)?**
> - No! We are heavily sponsored by SennaHosting.com and we only take donations to help keep Blue City alive and running!

> - **Who are the people behind Blue City?**
> - Blue City is made and founded by Blue and Cyan. Blue's socials can be found [here!](https://bluetools.framer.website/socials)
